summary: Iter 96 — Coach-created custom training plans. Backend + frontend end-to-end verified. Backend pytest (4/4 passed): POST /api/coach/create-plan returns a normalised preview (title/description/goals/weeks_count/days_per_week/weeks[7]) with cycling days carrying zone/duration/tss + strength/mobility + rest days. POST /api/coach/create-plan/accept returns {ok, plan_id:'custom-...', title}, /api/plan then reflects the custom plan (id=custom-..., current_week=1, workouts[] populated) and /api/calendar/week returns week-1 dates starting next Monday with cycling(workout_id=<plan_id>-ride-...) + fb50 + rest days. Frontend (1280x860, demo@roujaune.app): from /plan the header 'Create plan' (testID create-plan-btn) opens the creator modal (testID plan-creator); goal + weeks-4 + days-3 + Generate produced a preview (testID plan-preview) in ~10-30s; Accept (testID plan-accept) closed the modal and the Training Plan screen refreshed to show the new plan title/description/4 Weeks/3 Days/Week + fresh goals. From coach chat (testID message-coach → chat-create-plan) the same creator modal opens. Demo account was restored to build-and-climb via POST /api/rider/plan after testing.

issues: When a custom plan becomes active the header hero still shows 'Build & Climb' assets/imagery for a moment before it re-renders to the new plan (cosmetic, no functional impact).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/coach.py:1275 — _build_custom_definition sets `next_mon = today + timedelta(days=(7 - today.weekday()) % 7 or 7)` then overrides with `if today.weekday() == 0: next_mon = today`. The `or 7` branch on Monday is unreachable but confusing; consider simplifying to a single expression.
routes/coach.py:1214-1266 — coach_create_plan is a long function; the LLM prompt construction + JSON parsing could be extracted into a helper for reuse and unit-testability.
seed_data_creation: None. Demo rider's active plan was temporarily switched to a custom-<id> plan while accepting, then restored to build-and-climb.
